recent_excerpts: AI agents now discover and exploit obscure vulnerabilities autonomously, while AI-generated code floods pipelines with flaws. Defenders must adapt to agent-scale threats.
Rapid7 VP Christiaan Beek warns attackers are exploiting weak credentials and known flaws faster than defenders can patch — pace, not technique, is the 2026 differentiator.
Japan teen arrested for stealing 7M Kaikatsu Club records to buy Pokémon cards — one example of how AI tools are lowering the barrier for cybercrime in 2026, per The Hacker News…
